description:
Read shared Bangladesh retail-parts payment and delivery terms before explaining a purchase; get_part supplies item eligibility and prepare_part_handoff prepares the enquiry.

- No inputs: the same retail policy applies across items. Reuse it across a shortlist, then refresh before relaying fees; a buyer's address, basket or identity cannot personalize this call.
- Select the returned delivery zone using the buyer's area. Retail terms do not establish vehicle, auction or trade-credit terms; route car enquiries through prepare_vehicle_handoff.
- Money objects distinguish BDT from paisa; vat_bps is in basis points. If live_terms_unavailable is true, obtain human confirmation instead of inventing fees. This anonymous read accepts no quote or payment.
name: get_buying_guide
